story.summaryZh: 哈斯车队表示在墨西哥站有机会得分，但只能控制可控的部分，现在将专注于巴西站。

story.originalTitle: "I think we had a chance to score points for sure, but you have to take it on the chin – you can only control what you can control. Now, we move on t...
story.summaryEn:
"I think we had a chance to score points for sure, but you have to take it on the chin – you can only control what you can control. Now, we move on to Brazil." 🗣️ AK
Finishing off our time in Mexico City 🇲🇽
#HaasF1 #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh:
“我认为我们肯定有机会得分，但你要接受现实——你只能控制你能控制的事情。现在，我们继续前进到巴西。” 🗣️ AK
结束我们在墨西哥城的时光 🇲🇽
#哈斯F1 #F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
detailEn:
"I think we had a chance to score points for sure, but you have to take it on the chin – you can only control what you can control. Now, we move on to Brazil." 🗣️ AK
Finishing off our time in Mexico City 🇲🇽

relatedItems.summaryEn:
"I think the baseline is good, and it’s now at the fine-tuning stage of understanding what we can do better on the medium and hard compounds, and at the same time, getting a bit more out of the soft tire." 🗣️ AK
Wrapping up Friday in São Paulo 🇧🇷
#HaasF1 #F1 #BrazilGP
detailZh:
“我认为基础线很好，现在正处于调整阶段，了解我们可以在中硬胎上做得更好的地方，同时，从软胎上得到更多。” 🗣️ AK
在圣保罗结束周五的比赛 🇧🇷
#HaasF1 #F1 #巴西大奖赛
detailEn:
